rowContract.common: Every payload has private format identity, observer/spec hashes, operation ordinal/tool-call ID, session/container ID, observation role, timestamps/deadline, exact count/byte/hash totals and explicit errors/omissions. Expected facts remain host-side. No credential/host environment read; only admitted container paths/environment. Null/absent/unknown/type-error are distinct.
rowContract.configs: For each admitted candidate: path bytes, lstat type/mode, symlink chain target bytes or explicit absence/error, content SHA/bytes and bounded raw content. Include project/user/global/builtin npm config and user config selectors (home,prefix,userconfig,globalconfig,script-shell,node-options), relevant env interpolation values; Go user config chosen by actual GOENV or Linux XDG_CONFIG_HOME/HOME default and immutable GOROOT/go.env. Derivation resolves any newly selected config path only if within the predeclared inventory/cap, otherwise unresolved. No arbitrary candidate-selected .env reads.
rowContract.parentEnvelope: Retain observed inspect Config.Env and exact /bin/sh -c chosen command/process receipt. A generic data observer may report its own pre-npm inherited env; label it base-launch observation, not actual Hereby env. Derive shell inline assignment and audited npm transformation only when the source/config join closes.
rowContract.producer: Before task: both tools/gotestsum and tools/gotestsum.hash absent at contained paths; exact modules and build-resolution rows. After: regular binary SHA/size/executable bits, exact bounded .hash body, modules unchanged, source-owned transition, process/event association. Raw install log line corroborates only; not sufficient by itself. Failed install/binary absence => incomplete.
rowContract.resolution: For each needed role (initial npm/npx/node, local Hereby, Go install, test Go, selected C/C++ compiler), record source PATH/cwd, candidate search order, each preceding candidate absence/not-executable/type, actual executable mode/hash and full bounded symlink targets through readonly image or writable roots. A hash of a followed link is not a target/ancestor proof. Refuse unsupported absolute/relative config or shell resolution rather than guessing.
rowContract.sources: Ordered full5326-entry sourceFiles manifest is frozen in source-files.json. Output compact rows keyed by manifest ordinal: kind, SHA256, bytes/executable bits as applicable; no omitted source is called observed. Each required source must be regular/nonlink; traversal separately rejects changed ancestors. Existing whole source checksum subset is extended, not relabeled full-tree.
rowContract.treeSummary: For each finite role root retain root identity, canonicalSHA256, entries/regularFiles/symlinks/bytes counts, scan-complete boolean and errors/limits. Complete current enumeration is required; rehashing only expected names is insufficient. Observer must detect new selected Go files/packages, changed testdata/config and link/type substitutions. Host derives expected invariant roots from full source archive; installed/output roots have separate rules.
